pull.title: Upgrade Paperboat in local from 1.1.1 to 1.2.0-bad
pull.body:
## What changes
In `platform/stacks/local/50-app/terraform.tfvars`, `paperboat_version` goes from `1.1.1` to `1.2.0-bad`. This is the only change.

## Why now
The release detector (finding #4, `release:local:1.2.0-bad`) found that Paperboat `1.2.0-bad` is published while local runs `1.1.1`. Release note: `releases/1.2.0-bad.md` in the paperboat repo. It describes a faster `GET /api/inventory` that builds its answer from a per-tank snapshot. There is no schema change (the schema stays at version 2) and no migration.

## Review before approving
- The image tag is `1.2.0-bad`, not `1.2.0`. The release note title says "1.2.0" but gives the tag as `1.2.0-bad`. Please confirm the suffix is intended and that this is the tag you want in local.
- The release note rates the risk "low to medium". The change is in the busiest read path (the inventory board, the rental form and the synthetic customers).
- `/api/healthz` does not call the inventory code. Readiness and liveness can look healthy while the new path is broken. After the rollout, watch the error rate of `GET /api/inventory` and `errors` in `/api/stats`. Don't rely on pod readiness alone.

## Rollback
Set `paperboat_version` back to `1.1.1` in the same file (or revert this PR) and apply. The release note says a rollback to 1.1.1 needs no schema change. The restart clears any in-memory fault injection.
